    "C3 the preference aligns with the voice turn-taking rule that responses should adapt to conversational shifts"

    { "name": "overview_response", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R gives a brief overview of the topic and asks the user what to focus on, rather than listing every detail at once",

    { "name": "overload_response", "arity": 1,
